Not recommended
Feb 2026 • Friends
Food was alright. We had a la carte as buffet was not available. They charged an entrance fee with a drink included and if we spend more than a certain amount of money at the restaurant, we’ll get the ticket refunded. We spent a lot of money at the restaurants but made a mistake of claiming the free drink which is water and didn’t get the ticket refunded. Ridiculous policy. The warning was in Vietnamese, not English. Feels like a cheap scam. Won’t come back again. Watch out for similar “fine prints” in these touristy places.

Great Experience of Vietnam Cooking at the Class - Recommended
Nov 2025 • Couples
My wife and i enjoyed our experience at Nha Trang Xua Cooking Class immensely. Guided by the impressive "Quang" and "Y"..... the local Vietnamese handicraft making and culture was demonstrated and explained so well. To top it off we had so much fun with chef "Linh" learning to make delicious Beef Pho, Seafood Rolls and my own favourite Seafood Pancake (Bun Xeo). Thankyou for a spectacular experience and insight into Vietnamese cooking and flavours. We were so impressed and would highly recommend this trip to your Restaurant. Well done and a big thankyou to you all.
